description: OL W1c·S3 — H5 with the lane on: a relative period the core did not bind. `posledních 12 měsíců` reaches the lattice only as NER's duration P12M (no chrono ref, no interval), so nothing in the core says WHICH twelve months. The prompt states the reference date (2026-11-16) and the value as it was grounded; the query restricts to the twelve whole months before the reference month, [2025-11-01, 2026-11-01). `plánem` stays carried: the slice has no plan, the LLM claims no span, and gaps_carried is still the core's account.
invariants: the lane is what emit does when it is on; the verdicts do not change and nothing in it binds (OL-C11)
the door runs the query under the CALLER's subject, whoever wrote it (OL-C12)
a relative period is counted from the reference date the prompt states, never from the model's own idea of today
the LLM's claim (llm_handled) sits beside gaps_carried and never edits it (OL-C17)

args.text: Ukaž vývoj nákladů střediska 220 za posledních 12 měsíců a porovnej s plánem.

replies.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', e.booked_on) AS mesic, SUM(e.amount) AS naklady FROM er.entity.cost_entry e JOIN er.entity.cost_center c ON e.cost_center_id = c.cost_center_id WHERE c.code = '220' AND e.booked_on >= DATE '2025-11-01' AND e.booked_on < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', e.booked_on) ORDER BY mesic
replies.note: the 12 whole months before 2026-11; no plan in the slice
